escena: SCENE (documentary still, an Efeonce SEO strategist at work late in the evening, the moment she compares how Google and an AI assistant answer the same question): a Latin American woman in her early thirties, dark hair tied back, wearing the Efeonce softshell jacket from the reference, seated at a dark desk in the RIGHT 65% of the frame, turned three-quarters toward the LEFT, leaning in toward a current thin laptop whose screen faces away from camera at a steep angle, so nothing on it can be read; its cool white glow is the key light on her face, hands and jacket from below and in front; her eyes focused, one hand on the trackpad, the other holding a pen just above the desk, mid-thought. A hard low rim from a second source behind her right shoulder separates her hair and shoulder from the wall. 85mm lens at f/2, camera at her eye level about two meters away, focus on her eyes. Contemporary room: a bare, evenly shadowed dark plaster wall behind her; no plants, no books, no printed paper, no lamps, no shelves anywhere in the frame, not even out of focus. The desk holds only the laptop and a plain azure-blue (#0375DB) notebook, closed. Nobody looks at the lens. The LEFT 30% of the frame, from top to bottom, is only the bare, evenly shadowed dark plaster wall: no light, no bright edge, nothing in it. Rich contrast, deep blacks, no readable text, no logos of any other brand.

lecho.objeto: the edge of the dark oiled-wood desk on the camera side, dissolved into blur and outside every light

texto.muro: the calm, evenly shadowed plaster wall on the left 30% of the frame
